test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which Indian state will you find Mount Tiyi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Tiyi is situated in Wokha in Nagaland. **

 
• Nagaland is a state in North-Eastern India.
 
• It is bordered by the state of Arunachal Pradesh to the North, Assam to the West, and Manipur to the south and Myanmar to the East.
 
• **Its Capital is Kohima.**
 
• **Its Largest City is Dimapur.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
